rationale: Sizing measurement before fixing any comparison family, per CLAUDE.md. No performance means, Sharpe, ranking or promotion verdict are output.
Use rd-aa's single 3x/60-observation activity definition and rd-z's months-long 20-name cash-equity shape. This is a reference geometry, not a candidate selected for its performance.

Select at formation close using only prior completed observations; hash-order eligible names with the fixed seed. Attempt entries at the following open. Unfilled orders remain cash without hindsight replacement.

Frozen bars never enter a baseline or make a name eligible; equal OHLC with positive turnover remains eligible. Daily-open fills on limit-locked bars are an explicit unverified queue assumption and counted.

Operator choice 2026-10-05: carry halted holdings at last observed price, defer sales until a non-frozen bar, and retain unresolved marked inventory. Missing-price days get the same conservative no-sale treatment. Never cash out at a retrospectively identified final bar or assume a -100% delisting recovery.

Existing per-era KOSPI/KOSDAQ total tax schedule applies on sale with index-calendar T+2 settlement; price returns exclude dividends. Commission and 5bp per-side slippage are modeling assumptions. 43.54bp sizing floor is the largest modeled round trip across the panel, not a claim about current fees or executable capacity.

One session-level portfolio return is the sampling unit. Report iid and circular block-bootstrap standard errors for 63/126/252 sessions; use the largest for the normal-approximation 80%-power sizing calculation. No permutation test or significance claim.

If the detectable daily effect exceeds the amortized round-trip cost floor, stop before specifying/running a comparison family and obtain the operator's choice. Unresolved holdings, absent symbols and instrument-type uncertainty remain disclosed limitations. No reserved pre-2019 prices are read.

Index dates through 2026-09-23 are read for settlement only. Both-direction index/scan date coverage must agree for the price panel. Completed fetch status is required; never-served and failed names are disclosed, not reclassified as nonexistent.
